criticism: The mintTokens function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply and balances variables are not checked for overflow, allowing attackers to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances variables are not checked for overflow, allowing attackers to transfer an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances variables are not checked for overflow, allowing attackers to transfer an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed variables are not checked for overflow, allowing attackers to approve an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The setPromo function allows the owner to set the promoValue to any value, which can be exploited to set it to a very high value, allowing attackers to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens.
